storage: SQLite FULL synchronous transactions + append-only hash chain
claim: oldest pending input; one unresolved claim; same round may retrieve same token
ack: delivery consumed, NOT verified progress; requires claim token, round and delivery receipt digest
ambiguous_recovery: new round blocks; explicit claim-hash-pinned replay/ack with reason and approver
retention: user instructions may be sensitive; keep local; explicit archive, never silent prune
